CPU.scope:
Actual65816 STOP-aware bank reuse; normal immutable522-command replay.

Every command polls sticky invalidation before packet DMA, after packet DMA,
after writes/zero DMA, and before ACK. STOP clears both bank flags and abandons
the command before acknowledging6006. Asynchronous STOP during an ACK is
rejected by the RTL gate and observed at the next poll.

STOP.scope:
Execute STOP cancellation on actual65816; endpoint status is a test model.

Packet DMA, zero DMA, validity publication, overlapping MVN, partial ACK and
short STOP pulses are covered. The separate RTL guard checks the same sticky
6001/6006 contract; this is not live CPU/FPGA co-simulation.

status.scope: Actual output owner: reset, short STOP, stale ACK and invalidation rearm.

ROMpad.scope:
Remove the retained legacy E0/E1 endpoint, preserving local program ROM/pad.

One Lite whole-board MAP. The separate bus guard does not qualify full board
CDC/IO/STA or link the complete65816 program.
